If someone supplied inflated rsETH as collateral and borrowed WETH against it, then when rsETH is devalued, the WETH reserve would have bad debt (deficit). But O03 shows no change in Aave rsETH supply — the minted tokens never entered Aave. So no bad debt in WETH reserve from this. Also WETH utilization is 86.6% — high but not 100%; there's 326k WETH idle, so withdrawals are fine.
